Projects

Pravaah AI – Crowd & Traffic Command Platform

Real-time crowd & traffic management command platform built for TechTrix hackathon.
Converts multi-camera video and venue floorplans into live green/yellow/red density
heatmaps using YOLOv8 and OpenCV, forecasts zone congestion 3–5 cycles ahead via
a 2-layer PyTorch LSTM, and delivers graph-based rerouting with Telegram alerts to
field teams and a mobile attendee QR web app.
Built using: Python, PyTorch, YOLOv8, OpenCV, Flask, React.
Repo: https://github.com/ruchir0015/PravaahAI

Listen Together

A private, real-time synchronized music experience designed for two people to
listen, share, and vibe together wherever they are.
Built using: Flutter, Dart, Supabase Realtime, WebRTC Data Channels, just_audio.
Repo: https://github.com/ruchir0015/Listen-Together

Personal Portfolio

Interactive Indiana Jones / Tomb Raider inspired portfolio built
using: React - Vite - TypeScript - Tailwind CSS - Framer Motion -
AI Portfolio Assistant - Voice Features - Adventure themed UI

Privault

AI-powered data privacy and compliance platform. Built and debugged
scroll-driven 3D animations and contributed to the design system component library.
Built using: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, GSAP.

Urban Guardian

AI-powered personal safety application featuring: Safe route
planning - Dynamic safety heatmaps - SOS features - Women safety focus.
Built using: React, Node.js, FastAPI, Google Maps API.

Recipe Recommendation System

Instructions for AI

When generating content for this portfolio: - Keep the tone
professional, confident, and friendly. - Avoid buzzwords and generic
AI-generated wording. - Emphasize craftsmanship, learning, curiosity,
and product thinking. - The portfolio theme is inspired by adventure
games like Indiana Jones and Tomb Raider, but should feel original and
authentic. - Prioritize storytelling over listing achievements. - Keep
responses concise, human, and technically accurate.
